prompt: List and describe every single human cell in detail.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 best addresses the user’s intent by explicitly noting the impossibility of listing every human cell type and then providing a fairly broad set of major, recognizable human cell categories with generally correct descriptions. Candidate 2 contains serious factual errors (e.g., stating red blood cells have an inner nucleus, and similar issues about white blood cells/platelets), which strongly undermines correctness despite being loosely structured. Candidate 3 provides several major cell types with mostly plausible descriptions, but it still does not come close to “every single” cell and lacks an explicit limitation/coverage statement. Candidate 4 focuses almost entirely on neurons, making it a major coverage failure relative to the prompt.
